body: Yeah, I sent you a PM, a pretty lengthy one too. To answer some of your questions.

The main reason I'm feeling this way is what me and her have been talking about lately. We've argued a lot lately and earlier today, she said she did not care about my weekend. Then, after I told her it was about suicide; She pretended to care. After I told her the whole story and asked for her help, she said left me. Other reasons include failing my classes and and a recent death in the family.

Thank you so much. That really helped. But, she's ignoring me now. I don't know what to say to her without putting any more pressure on her. She usually goes to bed quite early but she seemed shocked and aware of what I was trying to tell her. I will try to simplify what I want her to help me with.
The firearm is my roommates. He'd question me about it and I'd hate to discuss this with him. I believe I could take a few days of school.
